cohort: Women between 18-25 years of age, either primigravida or multigravida, with >28 weeks gestation, without previous uterine surgeries, who underwent LSCS.
finding: Cephalopelvic disproportion followed by fetal distress and failed induction were common indications for LSCS in primigravida, while non-progressive labor followed by failed induction and malpresentation were common indications for LSCS in multigravida.
